methodology: Full MDX and bibliography screening, with targeted primary-guideline and major-trial verification of named claims. Checked does not mean every numerical claim, reference, figure or drug/device label is validated. Unresolved entries explicitly identify unread work.

pages.title: Acute Urinary Retention
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Removed obsolete no-RCT decompression claim; distinguished rapid/gradual AUR evidence from a small chronic-retention trial.
Scoped inpatient URECA thresholds, RetenWorld median five-day catheterization, female coded-retention denominator, catheterization quality program and small fluoroscopic series.

Corrected bacteriuria versus CAUTI, clot-catheter caliber, blind-guidewire escalation, SPC contraindications, short-term catheter evidence, fluid replacement individualization and retention treatment claims.
pages.notes: Full MDX including 31 original refs read; nine primary abstracts and current relevant guidance checked. AUA BPH 2026 full treatment text unavailable; no claim to have validated a new universal TWOC interval. Drug-level dose review is outside this page pass.

pages.title: Bladder Trauma
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Full text and all references read. Three incorrect PMIDs repaired by exact title/author match, with actual primary abstracts read; Johnsen denominator corrected.
Distinguished ACS versus AUA/EAU catheter duration, cystogram follow-up, closure layers and pelvic-fixation recommendations; removed established SPT/hardware contraindication claim.
Traumatic IP repair distinguished from selected iatrogenic perforation; inspect for additional injury without mandatory widening.
pages.notes: Protocol contrast concentrations were screened for internal consistency, not separately audited for every local formulation.

pages.title: Necrotizing Fasciitis / Fournier's Gangrene
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Removed empiric carbapenem monotherapy without MRSA coverage and blanket penicillin-allergy options; aligned antibiotics/duration/relook timing with IDSA.
Corrected reversed CRP ratio and no automatic reoperation cutoff; CT/LRINEC sensitivity scoped to original NSTI meta-analysis.
Tom 487 is single-center all-NSTI, with percent wound area rather than patient closure rate; repaired fabricated bibliography.
Repaired four unrelated PMID links and incomplete Abbasi/Susini entries by actual titles; corrected mortality, volume association and modern sex/denominator estimates.

Susini original abstract/results denominators disagree (576/593); disclosed and avoided overprecise pooled percentages. Removed universal free-flap/PROM absence and fixed reconstruction-time assertions.
pages.notes: IDSA relevant full sections and Susini full relevant results checked; Tom abstract/indexed tables and Eray methods/results checked. No universal review of every antimicrobial dose or all reconstructive techniques claimed.

pages.title: Genital & Scrotal Trauma
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Full text and references read. Urgent testicular repair clarified rather than a 72-hour permitted wait.
Removed uniformly good replant outcomes, unsupported rigid glans/penis ischemia cutoffs and recurrent self-amputation percentage; retained urgent microsurgical assessment and support.

Pediatric forensic assessment no longer routinely requires speculum or anesthesia for suspected abuse alone; AAP direct full relevant passage requires suspected intravaginal injury for anesthetized vaginoscopy.
CT requires adequate stability; animal-bite rabies prophylaxis exposure-specific.
pages.notes: ACS >5-cm vulvar hematoma and bite-closure instructions retained as ACS guidance; not a separate comprehensive gynecology/ID guideline reconciliation. Replantation specialist atlas owned elsewhere.

pages.title: GU Injury Overview
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Full text and references read. Removed false cross-organ AAST I–III conservative/IV–V operative rule; qualified hematuria and unstable-patient imaging.
Corrected Siram PMID (previous linked radial-head dislocation) and its ureteral incidence denominator; removed ungrounded universal 10% pelvic-fracture urethral injury rate.
Corrected AUA 2020 amended-guideline PMID 33064586 (ant behavior) to exact guideline record 33053308.
pages.notes: Broad organ-incidence estimates otherwise not individually rederived; current kidney grading detailed on renal page.

pages.title: Trauma & Emergencies
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Full index read; descriptions no longer imply shared AAST management thresholds, a negative hematuria rule-out, LRINEC as the diagnostic focus or blind guidewire before cystoscopy.
pages.notes: Index overview only; organ details reviewed separately.

pages.title: Intraoperative Consultation
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Reversed detection-timing OR direction corrected; normal jets do not exclude partial/thermal ureteral injury.
Ligation requires prompt nephrostomy; no universal 5–7-day repair, no autotransplant in active peritonitis, no universal follow-up contrast before every device removal.
Bladder closure/cystography guideline differences aligned with companion; selected iatrogenic IP exception and cohort detection/catheter-duration limits explained.
Renal nephrectomy advice scoped to explored high-grade life-threatening renal hemorrhage rather than all instability; segmental ligation can sacrifice territory.
Added 2024 randomized prophylactic stent evidence, corrected nonexistent colorectal stent-versus-no-stent RCT claim, and removed causal procedure comparisons.
pages.notes: Entire page and bibliography read. WSES relevant full paragraphs, ACS renal/ureteral sections and original abstracts checked; 2024 stent meta-analysis is scoped to complex gynecologic surgery. Book chapter/Skokan diagram not accessed; no claim to independently reproduce or validate every element of that attributed schematic.

pages.title: Cesarean Section
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Replaced unsupported primary/repeat/PAS GU injury rate table with actual operation-specific systematic-review denominators; repaired two unrelated DOIs and invented combined Hemal reference.
Corrected PAS risk indexing (3% no prior CD), routine prophylactic balloon/stent claims, forceful placental removal warning and cesarean-scar-pregnancy urgency.
Corrected dominant lateral hysterotomy extension advice (cephalad-caudad benefit), unproven bladder-flap and incision-scar assertions, and impossible later prostatectomy example.
Niche meta-analysis three-month CI includes zero despite original significance wording; 2Close attrition and rare outcome limits; endometrium-free closure framed as expert/observational proposal.
Removed panniculus-prevention claim unsupported by subcutaneous-fat RCTs, aligned exteriorization/peritoneum guidance, corrected fixed trigonal/ureteric anatomy and VUF continence claims.
pages.notes: Entire text and all original refs read; all 27 DOI primary abstracts retrieved, plus corrected source abstracts, relevant full 2024 overview and 2025 niche results, current NICE/ACOG/SMFM passages. No obstetric operator-level certification; unsupported exact risks were removed rather than inferred from unrelated studies. Original niche meta-analysis has internal statistical inconsistency, explicitly retained as limitation.

pages.title: Procedures Causing GU Injury
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Entire landing page and planned-addition descriptions read; index has no therapeutic protocol or numeric outcome to source-check.
pages.notes: Checked navigation/context only; planned pages do not represent completed articles.

pages.title: On-Table (Single-Shot) IVP
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Separated historical 2 mL/kg protocol from product-specific FDA-labeled contrast doses; documented apparent ACS mg/kg typo without copying it.
Corrected CTU-for-all claims, bladder/urethral imaging exceptions, 2001 elective IVP indications as historical, and nonopacification not proving agenesis/nonfunction.
Scoped Morey 50-person observational study and removed unsupported universal ureteral CT accuracy and dye-test exclusion claims.
pages.notes: Entire page and bibliography read; original Morey and seven other primary abstracts, ACS relevant full text, and current DailyMed dosing tables checked. Remaining historical diagnostic accuracy ranges trace to guideline/review context, not an exhaustive meta-analysis.

pages.title: Penile Fracture
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Prompt repair replaces seven-day target; el-Assmy 180-patient early/delayed comparison had no significant difference, rather than all listed early benefits.
Corrected anterior bulbar/penile urethral anatomy and qualifying imaging, catheter and superficial penetrating injury advice.
pages.notes: Remaining detailed suture selection and postoperative intervals are practice examples, not independently compared protocols.

pages.title: Pelvic Fracture Urethral Injury (PFUI)
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Male complete PFUI scope and female early repair/bladder-neck exceptions; RUG suggests rather than proves completeness and DRE remains useful for rectal injury.

Corrected expanded Goldman classification attribution; MRI is an adjunct, not mandatory or an individual ED prognosis. PUA AUC belongs to combined model; Narumi predictor identity corrected and 27-person estimates limited; Schernuk 36/81 analyzed and combined predictor performance corrected.
Owen 2025 already present (OE96): eleven nonrandomized studies, no proven superiority and no demonstrated equivalence. Scarberry early-repair cohort not equivalence.

Repaired rerouting 3/4 denominator, Sa eligible ED denominator uncertainty, Plamadeala 49/70 sexual assessment and abstract/body discrepancy, Cavallo SUI 4/12 versus AUS 9/12, selected robotic populations and false causal comparison.
pages.notes: Entire text and 37 original refs read; 21 original abstracts plus Plamadeala full relevant results and ACS/EAU checked. Sa abstract gives 15/1.6% without eligible denominator; not repackaged as population risk. Detailed legacy operative technique not exhaustively independently validated.

pages.title: Priapism
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Corrected mixed phenylephrine protocol to explicitly labeled EAU regimen and monitoring; removed unsupported fixed pediatric regimen.

Corrected Gelfoam as temporary, no absolute 24-hour aspiration cutoff or mandatory implant at 36 hours, distal-shunt incision anatomy and PSD study denominators; distinguished weak guideline option from default bilateral surgery.
Scoped El-Bahnasawy mixed-duration erectile denominator and low-certainty SCD prophylaxis; no proven hydroxyurea priapism prevention claim.
pages.notes: Full text and 23 original refs read; current EAU relevant full sections and AUA indexed original passages checked. Direct AUA PDF download failed; exact AUA phenylephrine appendix was not accessed, therefore no blended AUA dosing asserted. Original study verification mostly abstracts; not certification of all technical maneuvers.

pages.title: Renal Trauma
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Full text and 12 original references read. Corrected single-shot IVP mg/kg→mL/kg. Removed guaranteed whole-grade NOM percentages (misused AE outcomes), unsupported repeat-AE 97% claim, grade-V mandatory nephrectomy and negligible segmental functional-loss statements.

Corrected blanket no-follow-up-imaging rule with AUA deep-injury imaging and EAU individualized three-month major-injury review; hypertension ten-patient referral study does not imply majority need nephrectomy.
AAST 2025 identity and official adoption verified; existing 2018 table/diagram explicitly historical and relevant 2018 vascular wording repaired.
pages.notes: Unresolved: primary full 2025 grading table not retrieved (publisher 402); no new detailed 2025 table inferred from secondary summaries. Remaining operative vein-narrowing percentages and nomogram numbers not independently rederived.

pages.title: Testicular Torsion
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Corrected reversed manual-detorsion direction, first-year neonatal definition, possible preoperative sperm-banking delay, TWIST exclusion rule and universal Doppler accuracy.
Aligned confirmed torsion versus negative exploration fixation with FIX-IT expert consensus and neonatal approach with EAU.
Scoped nine original-study abstracts: mixed UDT/torsion procedure denominator, Lent procedures versus patients, single-case pressure, TVF high-bias evidence, single-cohort atrophy and recurrence.
pages.notes: Full EAU acute-scrotum chapter and relevant FIX-IT consensus sections checked; original cohort outcomes primarily abstract-verified, not all manuscripts or operative technical details certified.

pages.title: Trauma Assessment
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Full text and all references read. Corrected automatic pediatric CT for any hematuria and CT regardless of stability.
RUG first when feasible, single experienced urgent attempt exception and no force/repeated attempts; CT-before-RUG rationale is obscuring pelvic hemorrhage, not radiation.
Delayed excretory CT does not replace retrograde cystography; drainage choices individualized; removed laterality-of-hematuria bedside concept.
Corrected AUA 2020 amended-guideline PMID 33064586 (ant behavior) to exact guideline record 33053308.
pages.notes: ACS full relevant imaging/pediatric passages checked; secondary textbook zone-management details not independently certified.

pages.title: Ureteral Trauma
pages.readScope: entire MDX body and bibliography read
scope: Full text and references read; all seven PMID-only references linked unrelated articles. Repaired exact identity and read actual primary abstracts (AAST scale bibliographic record has no abstract).
Registry incidence and associated bowel/vascular denominators corrected; Kunkle 5/40 missed traumatic injuries separated from iatrogenic injury, Locke no longer supports ballistic injury.

Wenske 81% hydronephrosis resolution and Groen 11/143 failures replace unmatched generic cure rates; corrected bowel-prep requirement, TUU recipient selection, non-opacification inference and last-resort damage-control framing.
pages.notes: Full primary operative cohort manuscripts not accessed; reported study-specific outcomes derive from abstracts. Fixed follow-up 6–8 weeks is a practice example, not newly certified universal timing.
